data.description:
DOCUMENT THREAD-SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

FILE: docs/thread-safety.md (new file)

SECTIONS:
1. Thread-Safe Components
   - GitAutoCommitter (uses threading.Lock)
   - GraphWAL (file-based, atomic writes)
2. NOT Thread-Safe (single-threaded only)
   - ThoughtGraph (in-memory, no locks)
   - GoTManager (file-based operations)
3. Recommendations for multi-threaded usage

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- File exists at docs/thread-safety.md
- Covers GitAutoCommitter lock implementation
- Clear guidance on what's safe vs unsafe

VERIFY: test -f docs/thread-safety.md && wc -l docs/thread-safety.md
